row.why: He read Amal's الأسبوع الأول (noun + adjective) as an idafa, 'the week's beginning'. Amal asked why and explained that it means the first week, and at 53:51 she said 'صح. It would be the first week.'

rulings.why: A clear listening misread that Amal fixed out loud.
